title: Desktop Setup
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Tooling
description: Interactive vis-network diagram of the four Week 1 tools (Desktop, GitHub, VS Code, Unix shell) and the labeled relationships that connect them.

learningObjectives: Identify the four core tools used to set up an AI agent workflow: Desktop, GitHub, VS Code, and the Unix shell.
Explain how each tool controls or communicates with the others.
Explain why a per-project GitHub repository gives Desktop the ability to undo its own actions.

keyQuestions: Which tool does Desktop use to control GitHub?
Why does every project need its own GitHub repository before Desktop starts working?
commonMisconceptions: Students may assume Desktop edits GitHub directly, when it actually goes through the Unix shell and the gh command-line tool.
assessmentOpportunities: Ask students to trace the path a code change takes from Desktop to GitHub and back into VS Code.
